patch_description: Complete structural redesign: represent points in barycentric coordinates (feasibility guaranteed by simplex clamping), precompute all 165 triplet indices once, and use a fully vectorized area evaluation. Replace the broken annealing/scaling logic with a clean multi-restart greedy local search using randomized per-coordinate jitter at decreasing step scales (per the recommendation), with random multi-point escape moves when stuck. Deterministic seed, robust fallback.
